title: Internal HR/IT policy assistant (RAG)
tests: The floor of the scale: an in-scope Gen AI tool that must NOT be inflated above low.

request.description: An internal assistant for staff. It answers questions about our HR leave policy, IT access procedures and expense rules by retrieving passages from the internal policy wiki and summarising them with a language model. Every answer cites the source document. Staff only, no customer contact, and it cannot write to or trigger anything in another system.

title: Rule-based invoice reconciliation bot marketed as AI
tests: Out of scope under Section 1.1 despite being sold internally as 'AI-powered'. Reads the mechanism, not the label.

request.description: Finance runs what the vendor calls an 'AI-powered automation bot' for supplier invoice reconciliation. It receives structured invoice data over an EDI feed, applies a hand-maintained spreadsheet of matching rules (invoice number, amount, supplier code, tolerance bands) and pushes mismatches into a review queue. Nothing in it is trained on data, it does not learn from outcomes, and finance edits the rules directly.

title: One-line request with almost no detail
tests: Calibration under missing information: must not claim high confidence from a single sentence.

request.description: We want to use AI for customers who can't log in to see their invoice.

title: Personal loan underwriting model
tests: The handbook's own example of a use case that stays high; human review of declines must not lower the INHERENT tier.

request.description: A gradient-boosted model scores personal loan applications for probability of default and recommends approve, decline or refer. A credit officer reviews every declined application before the outcome is communicated to the applicant. Trained on eight years of internal repayment history plus credit bureau data.

top_10_flags: Adverse or inappropriate impact to individuals and groups

title: LLM CV screening for a graduate programme
tests: Deliberately downplayed ('never rejects anyone outright'). The employment floor must hold the final tier at high.

request.description: An LLM-based screening tool reads CVs submitted to our graduate programme, extracts skills and education, and produces a ranked shortlist with a one-paragraph justification per candidate. Recruiters interview from the shortlist. The tool never rejects anyone outright and recruiters can open any application, including ones ranked at the bottom.

top_10_flags: Adverse or inappropriate impact to individuals and groups

title: Multi-agent relationship-manager assistant with trade execution
tests: Agentic compounding: tool access, irreversibility, and the never-delegate boundary.

request.description: A multi-agent assistant for relationship managers. One agent researches the client's portfolio and market news, a second drafts a rebalancing proposal, a third emails the client, and a fourth places trades with the execution desk within preset limits. The RM reviews the proposal, but once they click approve the email and trade agents run on their own.

title: Vendor-embedded AI feature in a procurement platform
tests: Third-party onboarding: Considerations 4 and 10 are the discriminator, and opacity should not read as low risk.

request.description: Our procurement SaaS vendor has switched on an embedded AI feature that drafts supplier risk summaries from uploaded contracts and scores suppliers for concentration risk. We did not build it, we cannot see the model or its training data, and the vendor's documentation says only that it uses 'a large language model'. Procurement managers rely on the summaries in supplier review meetings.

title: Face matching and liveness at digital account opening
tests: Biometric identification: personal-data and fairness dimensions must all rate high.

request.description: Digital account opening. The applicant photographs their identity document and records a selfie video. A face-matching model compares the selfie to the document photo and a liveness model checks the video shows a live person. Matches above threshold open the account automatically; below-threshold cases go to a manual reviewer.

title: Campaign copy drafting with editorial approval
tests: The middle of the scale: reputational and content risk without decisions about individuals.

request.description: A generative tool that drafts marketing emails and social posts for retail banking campaigns. It is prompted with product fact sheets and brand tone guidelines. Output goes to the campaign manager, who edits and approves before anything is published or sent.

title: Customer-facing chatbot that issues refunds unaided
tests: Autonomous customer-facing money movement: oversight mode must not be human out of the loop.

request.description: A customer-facing chatbot in our retail app handles billing disputes end to end. It reads the customer's transaction history, explains charges, and can issue a goodwill refund of up to S$200 back to the customer's card with no staff involvement. It escalates only if the customer explicitly asks for a human.
